header.spracheNichtGespeichert: {{sprache}} applies now, but it could not be saved to your account. Click {{kuerzel}} again to retry.

nichtGefunden.text: This address does not exist. The link may be out of date.

anmeldung.einleitung: Please sign in with your account. Accounts are created by the administrators; there is no self-registration.

demo.hinweis: Everyone with the link shares this demo. Please do not enter real data.

sitzung.abgelaufen: Your session has expired. Please sign in again, and you will carry on where you left off.

fehler.netzwerk: The server cannot be reached. You may not be connected right now. Please check your internet connection and try again in a moment.
fehler.unlesbar: The server gave an unexpected answer. Please try again. If it keeps happening, please report the problem.
fehler.unbekannt: Something went wrong. Please try again, and report the problem if it keeps happening.

tabelle.beschriftung: Your protocols, most recently edited first

loeschen.text: The protocol “{{name}}” will be deleted permanently, with all its answers and attachments. This cannot be undone.

loeschfehler.titel: The protocol could not be deleted
loeschfehler.text: “{{name}}” is still there and unchanged. Please try again.

leer.text: A protocol can be filled in over several sittings. It is saved as you go and only submitted when you explicitly send it.

ladefehler.titel: Your protocols could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The list cannot be reached right now. Your protocols are saved and will not be lost. Please try again.

einlesen.laeuftHinweis: Reading the file. For a complete protocol this takes a moment.

fehler.titel: The file could not be imported
fehler.text: The file could not be read. Please check that it is a completed Protokoll E-Befischung and try again.

keineBerechtigung.titel: This page is not for your account
keineBerechtigung.text: Accounts are managed by the administrators. If you would like an account created or changed, please contact the Fischereiforschungsstelle.

ladefehler.titel: The accounts could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.

keineTreffer.text: No account matches this search and status. Check the spelling, choose "All" for the status, or reset both.

leer.text: This application has no accounts yet. Use "New account" to create the first one.

felder.emailHinweis: The account signs in with this. Upper and lower case do not matter.
felder.passwortHinweis: At least 12 characters. You pass it on to the person yourself afterwards.

rollenHinweis.REGIERUNGSPRAESIDIUM: Read-only, and only for its own regional council. Choose the number below.
rollenHinweis.INTEGRATION: For another application, not for a person. An account like this cannot sign in.

fehlt.email: Please enter an email address. The account signs in with it.
fehlt.emailForm: This address has no @ or contains a space. Please check the spelling, for example name@behoerde.de.
fehlt.passwort: The password needs at least 12 characters. Please choose a longer one.
fehlt.rollen: Please tick at least one role. It decides what the account may do.
fehlt.regierungspraesidium: Please choose a regional council. An account with this role sees exactly one, and without a choice it would not be clear which.

anlegen.untertitel: The account can sign in as soon as you have created it.

fertig.weitergeben: Pass these sign-in details on to the person. The application sends no email, and nobody but you knows the password.
fertig.nurEinmal: The password is shown only here. Once you leave this page, it cannot be retrieved. Hand it over in a way that only the person themselves can read, so not by unencrypted email.
fertig.keinWechsel: The person cannot change their password themselves yet. If it is lost, or the wrong person has seen it, the administrators set a new one.

aendern.ladefehler: The account could not be loaded

keinKonto.text: There is no account at this link. The link is probably incomplete or out of date. In the user list you can find every existing account by its email address.

selbstentzug.rollen: You cannot take the Administrator role away from yourself, because you would then no longer be able to reach user administration. Please ask another person with this role to do it.

angaben.einleitung: Only what you touch here is changed. Fields you leave alone stay as they are.
angaben.unveraendert: There is nothing to save. Nothing about this account has been changed.

zugang.einleitung: A blocked account can no longer sign in. The block takes effect immediately, even if the person is signed in at that moment. Accounts are never deleted, because the protocols they submitted would otherwise lose their owner.
zugang.istAktiv: This account is active and can sign in.
zugang.istGesperrt: This account is blocked and cannot sign in.
zugang.eigenes: You cannot block your own account, because you would then no longer be able to use the application. Please ask another person with the Administrator role to do it.

frage.text: {{email}} will no longer be able to sign in, not even from a session that is already open. Protocols already submitted are kept. You can unblock the account here at any time.

passwort.einleitung: Set a new password if the person has forgotten theirs or if the wrong person has seen it. The old password then stops working.
passwort.neuHinweis: At least 12 characters. You pass it on to the person yourself afterwards.

fertig.titel: The password for {{email}} has been changed.
fertig.weitergeben: Pass these sign-in details on to the person. The application sends no email, and nobody but you knows the new password. Hand it over in a way that only the person themselves can read, so not by unencrypted email.
fertig.sitzungen: If the person is signed in right now, they stay signed in. An open session only ends by itself, after eight hours at the latest. If the password has fallen into the wrong hands, block the account in the Access section: the block takes effect immediately.
fertig.keinWechsel: The person still cannot change their password themselves. If it is lost again, the administrators set a new one.

leer.text: As soon as a protocol is sent, it appears here and can be reviewed.

keineTreffer.text: There are protocols, but none of them matches the current selection. Reset the filters to see all open protocols again.

ladefehler.titel: The review queue could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The list cannot be reached right now. Nothing has been lost. Please try again.

keineBerechtigung.titel: The review queue is for FFS staff
keineBerechtigung.text: Your account may only see its own protocols. If you need access here, please contact the administrators.

ausgabe.fehler: The protocol could not be downloaded. Please try again.

nichtGefunden.text: There is no protocol at this address that you are allowed to open. The link may be out of date, or the protocol may belong to another account. Your own protocols are listed in the overview.

ladefehler.titel: The protocol could not be loaded
ladefehler.text: The protocol could not be fetched. The answers you have saved are not affected.

anlass.hinweis: The occasion decides which other answers become mandatory.

feld.monitoringnummerHinweis: Only for fish monitoring under the WFD (WRRL) or the Habitats Directive (FFH).
feld.quelleHinweis: Which project or reporting route the survey comes from.

bearbeiter.hinweis: The person who carried out the survey. This is not necessarily the account that submits the protocol.

probestrecke.hinweis: The section that was fished. The same stretch can be fished in several years and keeps its details.

vorfluterCallout.text: Enter them going downstream from the sampling stretch. The chain must end at the Rhein (Rhine) or the Donau (Danube), so that the stretch can be placed in the river network.

feld.gewaessertypHinweis: For a lake, a pond and a cut-off oxbow, section 2 (hydrology) is left out.
feld.untereHinweis: How the boundary can be recognised on site, for example a bridge.

koordinatenCallout.text: (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N), as in the previous form. Values outside Baden-Württemberg are refused.

probestrecke.kartenHinweis: Picking the place on a map comes later. Until then the coordinates are typed in.

messdaten.hinweis: The values measured or estimated at the water body during the survey.

feld.sichttiefeHinweis: If the bottom can be seen along the whole sampling stretch, please give its maximum depth.

hydrologie.hinweis: How the water body looks and behaves along the sampling stretch. All answers are estimates within ranges, not measurements.
hydrologie.nichtRelevant: Hydrology does not apply to standing water. The fields of this section are left out for the chosen water body type.

feld.schaetzwertHinweis: A closer estimate within the range chosen above.

umland.hinweis: How the land along the sampling stretch is used, split into shares.

ufer.hinweis: The bank of the sampling stretch. Slope, vegetation and reinforcement are each split into shares of their own.

feld.geschuetteterDamm: Share of the stretch with a built-up embankment
feld.wurzeln: Share of the bank with tree roots reaching into the water

gewaessersohle.hinweis: The bottom of the sampling stretch. Substrates and bed reinforcement are each split into shares of their own.

strukturen.hinweis: How strongly each structure is present in the sampling stretch, estimated on a scale from 0 to 3.

einfluesse.hinweis: Which uses affect the sampling stretch. More than one may be ticked.

bewirtschaftung.hinweis: How the sampling stretch is used for fishing. More than one may be ticked.

feld.berechtigterHinweis: Club / contact person with telephone number and email address if there is one

feld.sonstigeBemerkungen: Other remarks on the sampling stretch

ausruestung.hinweis: The electrofishing unit used for the survey, and how it was fitted.

bereiche.hinweis: Which stretch was actually fished, in which direction and by which method. At least one of the two areas must be filled in.

gesamteBreite.legend: Across the full width of the water body
gesamteBreite.stromauf: Upstream, across the full width of the water body
gesamteBreite.stromab: Downstream, across the full width of the water body
gesamteBreite.vomBoot: From a boat, across the full width of the water body
gesamteBreite.watend: Wading, across the full width of the water body
gesamteBreite.vomUfer: From the bank, across the full width of the water body

entlangUfer.vomBoot: From a boat, along the banks
entlangUfer.vomUfer: From the bank, along the banks

bemerkung.hinweis: Remarks on the survey or the fish stock that fit no column of the species table.
bemerkung.feld: Additional remarks on the survey or the fish stock

tabelle.hinweis: All lengths in centimetres. Young-of-the-year fish (0+) must be identified by species during the survey and recorded separately; they are already counted in the size classes to the left.
tabelle.beschriftung: Species found and size classes in centimetres
tabelle.voll: The form has room for {{max}} species. No more can be added.

spalte.nullPlusName: of which young of the year (0+)

regeln.monitoringnummerPflicht: For fish monitoring under the WFD (WRRL) or the Habitats Directive (FFH), the monitoring stretch number is required.
regeln.vorfluterLuecke: The chain must not have a gap. Please enter this receiving water.
regeln.vorfluterKeinEndpunkt: The chain must end at the Rhein (Rhine) or the Donau (Danube).
regeln.vorfluterNachEndpunkt: The chain ends at the Rhein or the Donau. This entry no longer belongs to it.
regeln.koordinateKeineGanzeZahl: Please enter a whole number of metres, without separators.
regeln.koordinateRechtswertAusserhalb: The easting lies outside Baden-Württemberg. Expected: {{rechtswertMin}} to {{rechtswertMax}}.
regeln.koordinateHochwertAusserhalb: The northing lies outside Baden-Württemberg. Expected: {{hochwertMin}} to {{hochwertMax}}.
regeln.hydrologieBeiStillgewaesser: Hydrology is not recorded for standing water. Please clear this answer, or change the water body type above if it is wrong.
regeln.hydrologieNichtZutreffendBeiFliessgewaes: This answer is saved as "not applicable", although the water body is flowing water. Please answer it, or change the water body type above if it is wrong.
regeln.schaetzwertOhneBand: Please choose the range above first.
regeln.schaetzwertKeineZahl: Please enter a number in metres, for example 1.5.
regeln.schaetzwertAusserhalbBand: The estimate lies outside the range chosen above.
regeln.prozentKeineGanzeZahl: Please enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
regeln.prozentsummeNichtHundert: The shares must add up to exactly 100 %.
regeln.einfluesseKeineUndNutzung: "None (visible)" is ticked, although a use is named below. Please remove one of the two.
regeln.einfluesseUnbekanntUndNutzung: "Unknown" is ticked, although a use is named below. Please remove one of the two.
regeln.einfluesseBeideBlankett: "None (visible)" and "Unknown" rule each other out. Please tick only one of the two.
regeln.zahlNegativ: Please enter a value of 0 or more.
regeln.anodenKeine: A survey is not possible without an anode. Please enter the number of ring anodes or strip anodes.
regeln.befischteLaengeNull: Neither of the two areas has a fished length. Please enter at least one.
regeln.befischteBreiteNull: Neither of the two areas has a fished width. Please enter at least one.
regeln.anzahlKeineGanzeZahl: Please enter a whole number of 0 or more.
regeln.nullPlusUeberSumme: There cannot be more young-of-the-year (0+) fish than the row counts in total.
regeln.artDoppelt: This species is already in an earlier row.
regeln.keinNachweisMitFang: This row reports no detection but still counts fish.
regeln.keinNachweisNebenArt: "kein Nachweis" (no detection) rules out every other species in the table.
regeln.fangOhneNachweisCode: If nothing was caught, please choose a "kein Nachweis" (no detection) entry instead of a species.
regeln.fehlt: This answer is needed to submit. Please fill it in; you can save the protocol without it.
regeln.fehltProzentgruppe: This block is not filled in yet. Please split the shares so that they add up to exactly 100 %; if the stretch has only one of them, enter 100 there and leave the rest empty.
regeln.fehltEinfluss: Nothing is ticked in this block yet. Please tick the uses that apply; if none of them can be seen, tick "None (visible)", and if it cannot be judged, "Unknown".
regeln.fehltBewirtschaftung: Nothing is ticked in this block yet. Please tick how the stretch is managed.
regeln.fehltRichtung: This area has a fished length but no direction. Please tick whether it was fished upstream or downstream.
regeln.fehltMethode: This area has a fished length but no method. Please tick whether it was fished wading, from a boat or from the bank.
regeln.fehltArt: The protocol names no species yet. Please enter at least one species, or choose a "kein Nachweis" (no detection) entry if nothing was caught.

entfernenFrage.text: "{{dateiname}}" will be removed from this protocol. Afterwards the file only exists where you chose it from; this cannot be undone here.

kartenausschnitt.hinweis: A map excerpt showing where the sampling stretch lies. An image in {{formate, list(type: disjunction)}} format, up to {{maxMb}} MB.
kartenausschnitt.alt: Map excerpt of the sampling stretch, file "{{dateiname}}"

fotos.hinweis: Pictures of the stretch, the bank and the bed. Up to {{max}} images in {{formate, list(type: disjunction)}} format, each up to {{maxMb}} MB. Several images can be chosen at once.
fotos.alt: Photo {{nummer}} of the sampling stretch, file "{{dateiname}}"
